title: Marathon Split Pace Goal Adherence by Checkpoint
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:split
| stats avg(split_pace_min) as actual count as sessions by checkpoint
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*5.3/actual,1), goal_label="5.3"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average split pace in minutes per kilometre with a simple target for each checkpoint, showing where marathon split pace is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by checkpoint shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence checkpoint values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of checkpoint values with average split pace in minutes per kilometre and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which checkpoint settings help you hit your target for marathon split pace and which ones fall short.
